label: 🌍 Boundary by country
description: Look up the WKB MULTIPOLYGON boundary of a country from an ISO 3166 code (alpha-2 / alpha-3 / numeric), the country name, or a lat/lon point. Output is ready to pipe into export_to_map (mode=choropleth) for world-scale maps.

input_mode.label: Input mode
enumLabels: text · ISO code or country name column
auto · try text first, fall back to point

input_column.label: Country column
input_column.help: Column with an ISO alpha-2 (US), alpha-3 (USA), numeric (840), or full country name (United States). Case-insensitive.

output_column.label: Output column name
output_column.help: Name of the WKB geometry column added to the output. Companion columns are <name>_name, <name>_alpha2, <name>_alpha3, <name>_centroid_lat, <name>_centroid_lon.

resolution.label: Boundary resolution
enumLabels: country · 10m high detail (4.7 MB, ~254 entities incl. microstates)
world · 110m simplified (130 KB, ~177 entities, microstates omitted)
resolution.help: How detailed should the returned polygons be? Auto picks 110m when the input's geographic span exceeds 60° (world-scale render — detail won't be visible) and 10m otherwise. The chosen resolution is reported in the step's lookup_summary artifact. Combined with the choropleth renderer's dot-proxy logic, dropped microstates still appear as graduated symbols at world scale.
